record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>.<Fo><Fo> Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is he whose<Fi> transgression<WH06588> <FI>is<Fi> forgiven<WH05375><WTH8803>, <FI>whose<Fi> sin<WH02401> <FI>is<Fi>  covered<WH03680><WTH8803>. <RF>A Psalm...: or, A Psalm of David giving instruction<Rf>
Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> the man<WH0120> unto whom the LORD<WH03068> imputeth<WH02803><WTH8799> not iniquity<WH05771>, and in whose spirit<WH07307> <FI>there is<Fi> no guile<WH07423>.
When I kept silence<WH02790><WTH8689>, my bones<WH06106> waxed old<WH01086><WTH8804> through my roaring<WH07581> all the day<WH03117> long.

For day<WH03119> and night<WH03915> thy hand<WH03027> was heavy<WH03513><WTH8799> upon me: my moisture<WH03955> is turned<WH02015><WTH8738> into the drought<WH02725> of summer<WH07019>. Selah<WH05542>.

I acknowledged<WH03045><WTH8686> my sin<WH02403> unto thee, and mine iniquity<WH05771> have I not hid<WH03680><WTH8765>. I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will confess<WH03034><WTH8686> my transgressions<WH06588> unto the LORD<WH03068>; and thou forgavest<WH05375><WTH8804> the iniquity<WH05771> of my sin<WH02403>. Selah<WH05542>.

For this shall every one that is godly<WH02623> pray<WH06419><WTH8691> unto thee in a time<WH06256> when thou mayest be found<WH04672><WTH8800>: surely in the floods<WH07858> of great<WH07227> waters<WH04325> they shall not come nigh<WH05060><WTH8686> unto him. <RF>when...: Heb. of finding<Rf><CM>

Thou <FI>art<Fi> my hiding place<WH05643>; thou shalt preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> me from trouble<WH06862>; thou shalt compass<WH05437><WTH8779> me about with songs<WH07438> of deliverance<WH06405>. Selah<WH05542>.

I will instruct<WH07919><WTH8686> thee and teach<WH03384><WTH8686> thee in the way<WH01870> which<WH02098> thou shalt go<WH03212><WTH8799>: I will guide<WH03289><WTH8799> thee with mine eye<WH05869>. <RF>guide...: Heb. counsel thee, mine eye shall be upon thee<Rf>

Be ye not as the horse<WH05483>, <FI>or<Fi> as the mule<WH06505>, <FI>which<Fi> have no understanding<WH0995><WTH8687>: whose mouth<WH05716> must be held<WH01102><WTH8800> in with bit<WH04964> and bridle<WH07448>, lest<WH01077> they come near<WH07126><WTH8800> unto thee.
Many<WH07227> sorrows<WH04341> <FI>shall be<Fi> to the wicked<WH07563>: but he that trusteth<WH0982><WTH8802> in the LORD<WH03068>, mercy<WH02617> shall compass<WH05437><WTH8779> him about.

Be glad<WH08055><WTH8798> in the LORD<WH03068>, and rejoice<WH01523><WTH8798>, ye righteous<WH06662>: and shout<WH07442><WTH8685> for joy, all <FI>ye that are<Fi> upright<WH03477> in heart<WH03820>.<CM>
